title: Heuristics Update: OU calibration for pairs + transcript anonymization warning
rationale: Two new generalizable lessons from tonight's scan that will apply to future rounds beyond R29 and R31.
content:
### OU parameter calibration for pairs trading thresholds
- LESSON: Fixed ±2σ entry/exit is suboptimal for pairs trading. Calibrate entry threshold to OU half-life: fast pairs (half-life < 3 days) → ±1.5σ; medium (3-7 days) → ±2.0σ; slow (> 7 days) → ±2.5σ. Use σ_eq = σ/√(2θ) as the natural spread unit, not rolling σ.
- WHEN: Designing any pairs trading or stat-arb strategy that uses z-score entry/exit rules. Apply during R29 implementation.
- SOURCE: arXiv:2604.02035 (April 2026) — RL for Speculative Trading. Zhao, Tse, Zheng.

### Never anonymize public financial text before NLP processing
- LESSON: Anonymizing earnings call transcripts (removing company names, numbers, product names) destroys MORE signal than look-ahead bias. These tokens carry the highest information density for sentiment and specificity scoring. EDGAR transcripts are public — there is no reason to anonymize.
- WHEN: Any NLP pipeline on EDGAR earnings transcripts (R31 text-based PEAD, R28 EarningsQualityAgent, any future earnings NLP task).
- SOURCE: arXiv:2511.15364 (Nov 2025) — Anonymization and Information Loss. Wu, Yang, Ying.
